race.comment: AFTERMATH (1) led all the way to win the 2000m Mortlake Cup by almost five lengths under 60kgs two runs back. Put up a brave performance in the much tougher Ararat Cup over 2200m last start, beaten under a length in a desperate finish. Love Linda Meech on a front runner. Will prove very tough to catch despite the 62kgs steadier. The threat is FOUJITA SAN (3) who improved sharply last time out at the second run of the campaign, closing well to finish second at massive odds six weeks ago over 1700m at Caulfield. Kept ticking over with a recent jump-out win at Hamilton. Has not won in ages but this is the easiest race he has ever contested. UNSEEN RULER (6) thundered home only to miss in a photo in the Ararat Cup last start. Cherry ripe after three runs back - sure to be putting in the big ones late. Distance specialist RICH CHAMPAGNE (5) didn't measure up at Flemington in Cup week but this is a far more suitable assignment.
